name: How long does structural framing take during a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does structural framing take during a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most standard single-wall structural alterations, the framing phase takes between two and four days. Day one involves site prep, dust containment, and building temporary support walls. Day two focuses on removing the original studs and hoisting the engineered load-bearing beam into position. Subsequent days are dedicated to securing post supports, tying into existing joists, and coordinating rough-in work. If extensive plumbing stacks or electrical circuits run through the wall, coordinating sub-trades can add time before structural framing can be closed in.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing a single structural opening typically takes 2 to 4 days, including building temporary shoring, hoisting beams, and completing rough carpentry inspections.
